warnings: Axes: x = 1-5 at 3.00 + 4.50 + 3.00 + 2.50 (13.00); y = A-B-C at 3.00 + 2.00 (5.00). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03 (plan and Truss T1), S-04 (both roof views), A-03, A-07 and A-08. Vector CAD PDF with no usable text layer — every value read off the rendered page.

2''' (5.70) is the line printed as 2.70 + 1.80 between grids 2 and 3 on S-02 and A-03 (beam B2(+0.31), edge of S1). It is 2''' rather than 2' because Truss T1's 0.900 panel chain (S-03) puts ticks at 3.90 and 4.80 earlier in the same gap — dummy names follow position order (section 4 rule 4); the third truss panel point at 5.70 is the same point, so it is one line.

A'' (1.90) is the y line printed as 1.90 + 1.10 between A and B on S-02 and A-03 (beam B1(+0.31) under slab S1). It is A'' because the S-04 upper-roof overhang above A (A' = -1.00) shares A's prime sequence (section 4, before-origin rule).

Truss T1 (S-03) prints its panel chain against the 1-5 markers: 1.000 x3 | 0.900 x5 | 1.000 x3 | 0.833 x3, sub-totals 3.00 | 4.50 | 3.00 | 2.50, total 13.00. Every inner tick became a line per section 4 rule 4. 0.833 x 3 = 2.499 vs printed 2.50 — a 0.001 rounding in the drawing, absorbed by the last panel (4'' at 12.166).
Roof overhangs (S-04): 1.00 left of 1 and right of 5 on both roof views; 1.00 above A and below B on the upper (A-B) roof; 1.00 below C on the lower (B-C) roof -> 1', 5', A', B', C'.

z: ±0.00 = ระดับถนนภายใน (A-01 notes, A-07, A-08). The label ระดับหลังอะเส is printed twice (+3.08 and +3.51) so the value is kept in each id. Beam-top levels +0.10 / +0.13 / +0.31 come from the S-02 beam tags 'Bn (+x.xx)' (legend: ระดับหลังคาน). ระดับดินเดิม (S-05) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-07/A-08) print no value — kept with level_m null.

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-06 plus A-03 (floor plan), A-07 and A-08 (building sections). Not swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run: A-04 roof plan, A-05/A-06 elevations (they reprint the same level marks), A-09 bathroom, A-10 door/window schedule (opening sizes stay on the schedule elements), E-01, SN-01, SN-02. S-05/S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (footing sizes and depths, section sizes, slab thickness), which stay on their elements; the Truss T1 depth 0.832 stays on the T1 element.
